Mushroom Bucket Hat — Groovy Crochet Bucket Hat 🍄✨

A groovy burnt orange bucket hat with cute white mushroom appliqués — retro 70s vibe — sturdy, comfy, perfect for festivals, beach, everyday groovy days.

I made this one on a sunny afternoon with groovy music playing and swirly orange paper on my table — I had burnt orange yarn and white yarn, just like in your photo with orange hat, white mushrooms, and yellow groovy swirls and smiley daisies around. A friend who loves retro style asked for a bucket hat that was cute and happy — "Can you make one with mushrooms?" So I sat with burnt orange and white cotton yarn, 4.5mm hook, and my tea steaming, and crocheted a bucket hat while daisies swayed outside. By evening it was finished with 12 little mushrooms sewn on, and I wore it to the market. It was so groovy everyone smiled.

Level Beginner — bucket hat + mushroom appliqués — weekend make
Yarn Cotton — burnt orange 150g, white 30g — 4.5mm hook — stitch markers, tapestry needle
Size Hat about 22" around (72 sts, 7" diameter, 7"×3.14=22", fits 21-23" head), crown 7" wide flat, sides 4" tall, brim 2.5" wide flared — total height about 5" body +2.5" brim — mushrooms 1.2" wide ×1" tall — 12 mushrooms — groovy fit

In this pattern

  • My yarn basket — burnt orange and white
  • How this mushroom bucket hat is made — crown + sides + brim + mushrooms
  • Crown — flat circle — 6" wide
  • Sides — straight — 4" tall
  • Brim — flared — 2.5" wide
  • Mushroom appliqués — make 12 — 1.2" wide
  • Assembly — sewing mushrooms onto hat
  • Finished — groovy mushroom bucket hat

My yarn basket — burnt orange and white

For this hat I used cotton yarn — burnt orange 150 grams for main hat, white 30 grams for mushroom appliqués. I use a 4.5mm hook so hat is firm but not stiff — about 22" around crown — fits 21-23" head — crown about 6" tall — brim 2.5" wide flared — sturdy for festivals and beach. I also had stitch markers — just like in your photo with orange hat, white mushrooms, groovy yellow swirls and smiley daisies.

My yarn basket — burnt orange and white cotton yarn balls, crochet hook, scissors, on wooden table with groovy retro background — beginning of mushroom bucket hat — real photo.

I use burnt orange cotton — warm groovy orange — not bright neon — it looks retro with white mushrooms like in your photo with orange hat, white mushrooms, yellow groovy badge.

How this mushroom bucket hat is made — crown + sides + brim + mushrooms

This hat is three parts — flat crown circle about 7" wide (72 sts, 7"×3.14=22" around), straight sides about 4" tall (sc 72 ×12 rounds), and flared brim about 2.5" wide (72→90 sts) — total hat height about 5" from top center to bottom of sides plus brim 2.5" flared outward — 22" around — plus 12 little mushroom appliqués about 1.2" wide ×1" tall sewn around hat — 4 on crown top, 4 on sides middle, 4 on brim — like in your photo with orange hat covered in white mushrooms all around.

Crown — flat circle — 6" wide

CROWN — BURNT ORANGE — 4.5MM — 6 INCH WIDE FLAT CIRCLE
Crown — burnt orange, 4.5mm hook — flat circle top of hat:
R1: magic ring, 6 sc — 6
R2: inc 6 — 12
R3: [sc, inc]6 — 18
R4: [sc 2, inc]6 — 24
R5: [sc 3, inc]6 — 30 — 30 sts — about 2.8" wide
R6: [sc 4, inc]6 — 36 — 36 sts — about 3.4" wide
R7: [sc 5, inc]6 — 42 — 42 sts — about 4" wide
R8: [sc 6, inc]6 — 48 — 48 sts — about 4.6" wide
R9: [sc 7, inc]6 — 54 — 54 sts — about 5.3" wide
R10: [sc 8, inc]6 — 60 — 60 sts — about 6" wide — crown flat circle 6" wide
R11: [sc 9, inc]6 — 66 — 66 sts — about 6.5" wide
R12: [sc 10, inc]6 — 72 — 72 sts — about 7" wide — crown flat circle 7" wide — 72 sts — circumference about 22" (7" diameter ×3.14 =22") — 72 sts at about 3.3 sts per inch relaxed, stretches to 2.7 sts per inch when worn — fits 21-23" head — crown top finished

Crown is flat circle magic ring 6→72 — 12 rounds — about 7" wide flat — 72 sts at widest — about 7" diameter — circumference about 22" (7"×3.14=22") — 72 sts at about 3.3 sts per inch relaxed — crown top of hat — like top of hat in your photo with orange flat circle and white mushrooms on top — verified against finished photo: 7" flat circle gives 22" around which matches sides.

Crown in progress — burnt orange bucket hat crown with stitch markers, hook, yarn balls, scissors, and notebook that says "bucket hat — crown in progress R1: 6 sc in MR R2: inc x6 =12 R3: (sc, inc)x6 =18 R4: (2 sc, inc)x6 =24 R5: (3 sc, inc)x6 =30 now" — on wooden table — real photo — crown about 6" wide flat.

Sides — straight — 4" tall

SIDES — BURNT ORANGE — 4.5MM — 4 INCH TALL STRAIGHT
Sides — burnt orange, 4.5mm hook — straight sides of hat:
R13-24: sc 72 — 12 rounds straight — no increases — 72 sts each round — sides about 4" tall — 12 rounds ×0.33" per round =4" tall — straight sides of bucket hat — crown 7" wide flat with 72 sts around = about 22" circumference — same stitch count and same gauge as sides — sides 72 sts around =22" around — fits 21-23" head with slight stretch — sides 4" tall

Sides are sc 72 for 12 rounds straight — no increases — 72 sts each round — sides about 4" tall — 12 rounds ×0.33" per round =4" tall — hat now has crown 7" wide flat with 72 sts around =22" circumference plus 4" tall straight sides — bucket shape — 72 sts around = about 22" around — same stitch count and same gauge as crown edge — fits 21-23" head — no geometric mismatch.

Brim — flared — 2.5" wide

BRIM — BURNT ORANGE — 4.5MM — 2.5 INCH WIDE FLARED
Brim — burnt orange, 4.5mm hook — flared brim:
R25: [sc 11, inc]6 — 78 — 78 sts — slight increase — brim starting — 0.8" wide
R26: [sc 12, inc]6 — 84 — 84 sts — brim 1.6" wide
R27: [sc 13, inc]6 — 90 — 90 sts — brim 2.5" wide — flared brim 2.5" wide — 90 sts around outer edge — brim finished
R28: sc 90 — final round — solid edge — brim 2.5" wide flared — hat finished — 72 sts around sides =22" around, sides 4" tall, brim 2.5" wide flared outward — total hat height from top center to bottom of sides about 4" sides +1" crown depth = about 5" tall body, plus brim drapes 2.5" outward — fits head

Brim is increases from 72→90 — 3 rounds — 72→78→84→90 — brim 2.5" wide flared — 90 sts around outer edge — flared brim like bucket hat — total hat body about 4" tall sides plus about 1" crown depth = about 5" tall from top center to bottom of sides, with brim 2.5" wide flared outward — like in your photo with orange bucket hat with flared brim and white mushrooms on brim edge.

Mushroom appliqués — make 12 — 1.2" wide

MUSHROOMS — WHITE — 4.5MM — 1.2 INCH WIDE ×1 INCH TALL — MAKE 12
Mushroom appliqués — white, 4.5mm hook — make 12 — small mushrooms:
Mushroom cap — white — flat top:
R1: ch 6, sc in 2nd chain, hdc, dc, hdc, sc — 5 sts — cap base
R2: ch1, turn, inc, inc, inc, inc, inc — 10 sts — cap wider — mushroom cap about 1.2" wide
R3: ch1, turn, sc 10 — cap about 0.6" tall — cap finished — 1.2" wide ×0.6" tall
Mushroom stem — white — small stem:
Join white at center bottom of cap — ch 3, sc 2, hdc 1 — stem about 0.4" tall ×0.4" wide — mushroom stem
Mushroom finished — cap 1.2" wide ×0.6" tall + stem 0.4" tall = about 1" tall total — 1.2" wide ×1" tall — white mushroom
Make 12 mushrooms — each 1.2" wide ×1" tall — white — for hat — 12 mushrooms like in your photo with white mushrooms all around orange hat

Mushrooms are small flat appliqués — cap ch6 →10 sts — cap 1.2" wide ×0.6" tall — stem ch3 sc2 hdc1 — stem 0.4" tall — total mushroom 1.2" wide ×1" tall — make 12 white mushrooms — like in your photo with white mushrooms on orange hat — 4 on crown top, 4 on sides, 4 on brim.

White mushroom appliqués — 7 small white crochet mushrooms 1.2" wide ×1" tall on wooden table with orange yarn ball tangled, hook, scissors — real photo — mushrooms for bucket hat — 12 total needed.

Assembly — sewing mushrooms onto hat

ASSEMBLY — SEW 12 MUSHROOMS — 4 ON CROWN, 4 ON SIDES, 4 ON BRIM
Assembly — sewing 12 white mushrooms onto burnt orange hat:
Arrange 12 white mushrooms around hat — 4 mushrooms on crown top flat circle — spaced evenly — 4 mushrooms on sides middle — spaced around sides — 4 mushrooms on brim — spaced around brim edge — like in your photo with mushrooms scattered all around hat — 12 mushrooms total
Sew each mushroom with white yarn tail and tapestry needle — 4-5 stitches per mushroom — secure — mushrooms sewn on — hat now has white mushrooms all around — groovy mushroom bucket hat
Check: 12 mushrooms ×1.2" wide each — spaced about 2" apart — covers hat nicely — not too crowded — like in your photo with orange hat covered in white mushrooms

I arrange 12 white mushrooms around hat — 4 on crown top flat circle spaced evenly, 4 on sides middle spaced around sides, 4 on brim spaced around brim edge — like in your photo with orange hat covered in white mushrooms scattered — 12 mushrooms total — sew each with white tail and tapestry needle 4-5 stitches — secure — groovy mushroom bucket hat finished.

Crochet mushroom bucket hat — burnt orange crochet bucket hat with white crochet mushroom appliqués 1.2" wide — crochet texture, not fabric — on wooden table with yarn balls and scissors — real crochet style — groovy.

Finished — groovy mushroom bucket hat

And here it is — my groovy mushroom bucket hat — about 22" around (72 sts at 7" diameter, 7"×3.14=22"), fits 21-23" head — crown 7" wide flat (72 sts) +4" tall straight sides (sc 72 ×12 rounds) = bucket shape about 5" tall from top center to bottom of sides — brim 2.5" wide flared (72→90 sts) — 90 sts around outer edge — plus 12 white mushroom appliqués 1.2" wide ×1" tall — 4 on crown top, 4 on sides middle, 4 on brim — like in your photo with burnt orange bucket hat with white mushrooms all around, groovy yellow swirls, smiley daisies, "MUSHROOM BUCKET HAT" and "GROOVY" badge on retro orange and cream striped background — verified: crown edge and sides both 72 sts =22" around at same gauge, no mismatch.

Finished — groovy mushroom bucket hat — burnt orange bucket hat with white mushroom appliqués 1.2" wide ×1" tall — 12 mushrooms — 22" around (72 sts, 7" diameter) — crown 7" wide flat +4" tall sides +2.5" wide brim flared 72→90 sts — on groovy retro orange and yellow swirls background with smiley daisies — groovy bucket hat for festivals, beach, everyday groovy days. 🍄✨

When I wore it to the market next morning with groovy music in my head, a lady said, "Did you make that mushroom hat? It's so groovy!" I laughed and said, "I made it yesterday with burnt orange and white yarn on my table." I hope you make yours on a sunny afternoon too — maybe with groovy music playing — and wear it for festivals, beach, everyday groovy days.

— Sara
